extracted.name: Basil Chicken and Pasta
extracted.description: Tender morsels of chicken are sauteed in butter and seasoned with garlic and basil before being simmered with heavy cream and Parmesan cheese to make a delectably rich sauce for the pasta of your choice.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into 1/2 inch cubes
instruction_lines: In a large pot with boiling salted water cook rotini pasta until al dente. Drain.

Meanwhile, in a large skillet melt the butter or margarine. Add the chopped chicken and garlic, saute until lightly brown and juices run clear. Stir in the ground black pepper, dried basil, heavy cream, and grated Parmesan cheese. Bring to a boil and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes.
Toss drained pasta with basil sauce and serve immediately.
